title: Maybe an index
description:
Earlier you wrote search functions that returned `-1` for "not found". A magic number like that is easy to forget to check. `std::optional` puts "there may be no answer" into the type.

Write `std::optional<std::size_t> findIndex(const std::vector<int>& values, int target)`: the index of the first match, or `std::nullopt`.
hints: Loop with an index; `return i;` converts to the optional by itself. After the loop, `return std::nullopt;`.
